## File: facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/examples/paraphraser/paraphrase.py

Prompts

```
['run the paraphrase CLI tool to generate English paraphrases from input text via back-translation', 'run gen_paraphrases to translate English to French then back to English using multiple experts', 'run TransformerModel.from_pretrained to load a pretrained en2fr or fr2en transformer model', 'run en2fr.translate to translate an English sentence into French for back-translation', 'run fr2en.translate with an expert index to get a specific French-to-English paraphrase']
```

Usage

```
{'run_paraphrase_cli': 'run the paraphrase CLI tool to generate English paraphrases from input text via back-translation', 'run_gen_paraphrases': 'run gen_paraphrases to translate English to French then back to English using multiple experts', 'run_transformer_from_pretrained': 'run TransformerModel.from_pretrained to load a pretrained en2fr or fr2en transformer model', 'run_en2fr_translate': 'run en2fr.translate to translate an English sentence into French for back-translation', 'run_fr2en_translate_expert': 'run fr2en.translate with an expert index to get a specific French-to-English paraphrase'}
```
